headline: MIL @ HOU matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIL 3.69 at HOU 3.62, with a projected total of 7.31. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward HOU: MIL moved -0.54 runs while HOU moved +0.72, changing the projected margin by -1.25 runs. NRFI probability dropped -14.5%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Brandon Sproat has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for William Contreras, Garrett Mitchell, Jackson Chourio, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Braden Shewmake, Brice Turang because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
